description: The same Instance in Env A (left) and Env B (right): row counts, sizes, scans and DML per table (pg_stat_user_tables, top 300 by size). Tables are sorted descending.

panels.description: Tables of both envs, last n_live_tup (estimate, updated by ANALYZE) and total size. delta = B - A, delta_pct = delta / A; sorted by |delta|. Objects of one env only: see the Only in panels.

targets.query: SELECT last("n_live_tup") AS "rows_a", last("total_bytes") AS "size_a" FROM "$rp"."pg_table_stat" WHERE $timeFilter AND env = '$env_a' AND db_instance =~ /^$db_instance$/ AND datname =~ /^$datname$/ GROUP BY "datname", "schemaname", "relname"
